eod_summary: 0/3 picks hit target. Nifty closed -0.38% at 23431.5. All 3 oil/defence plays pulled back despite crude strength — global risk-off dominated.

picks.catalyst: Crude Oil WTI +1.41% to $94.34 — US-Iran military standoff at Strait of Hormuz
picks.logic: ONGC is India's largest upstream oil producer. Every $1/bbl rise in crude adds ~₹1,200-1,500 Cr annually to realization revenue. With Brent approaching $100 and the Kharg Island military standoff ongoing (no ceasefire in sight), the crude supply-risk premium is durable. ONGC moved only +0.98% yesterday — less pricing-in than OIL or HAL — leaving room for catch-up. Clean upstream exposure with no downstream drag.

picks.catalyst: Crude Oil surge on US-Iran escalation — pure-play upstream producer
picks.logic: Oil India Ltd is a pure upstream crude and natural gas producer — no downstream/retail exposure, making crude price benefit cleaner than ONGC. Stock rose 1.72% yesterday but crude has continued rising overnight (+1.41% more). Strong supply-risk premium from Strait of Hormuz tensions supports prices. Risk-reward favors continuation entry on early dip.

picks.catalyst: US-Iran military confrontation — India defence sector re-rating on geopolitical risk
picks.logic: The US-Iran military standoff (US strikes on Iranian tankers, Iran retaliation on US warships) is the most significant military escalation in the region in years. Global defence procurement sentiment surges in such environments. HAL (Hindustan Aeronautics Ltd) has an order book of ₹1+ lakh Cr and is the backbone of India's indigenous defence manufacturing. Already +3.62% yesterday — momentum pick for sustained geopolitical tensions. Entry on pullback to watch zone.
